title: Lowleaf Hollow - Glowmoss Wonder
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. Lydian-tinged G major (raised 4th C#). Lead is the glassy pulse12 bell timbre that hangs on the #4 before resolving; pulse25 carries the glassy bell ARPEGGIO (broken major triads with the Lydian glint) sparkling under the lead; tri_bass soft long breathy bass (pad stand-in); drums barely there. Vesper floats up through Lydian: lift D4->G4->A4, settle B4->A4->G4, overshoot stretched by the #4 (C#). 24-bar loop, voice-leads home.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Slow wondering phrases that hang on C#5 (#4) before resolving. Vesper lift D4->G4->A4, settle B4->A4->G4. The C# is the magic; let it linger.

tracks._note: Glassy bell arpeggio, slow broken major triads with the Lydian glint. G(GBD) - C#dim/Lydian color (C#-E-G uses the raised 4) - C(CEG) - D(DF#A). Sparkles under the lead.
